strings.midi.title: MIDI Setup — Sonar Quick Mixer
strings.midi.devices.title: MIDI Devices
strings.midi.devices.hint: Gray = not used. Duplicates like MIDIIN2 are hidden automatically.
strings.midi.devices.showHiddenTooltip: Show ports that were auto-hidden (e.g. MIDIIN2) or manually hidden
strings.midi.editLayoutTooltip: Open the layout constructor to add/move/remove controls on the grid
strings.midi.resetAllBindingsTooltip: Clear this device's hardware mappings and Sonar assignments, then restore the factory map
strings.midi.workflowHint: Select device → Use device → assign channels → Save changes
strings.midi.preset.saveAsTooltip: Save the current layout as a new named user preset
strings.midi.preset.renameTooltip: Rename the selected user preset (same file). Official presets are read-only — use Save as… first.
strings.midi.preset.importTooltip: Import a layout JSON as a new user preset
strings.midi.preset.deleteTooltip: Delete the selected user layout JSON file
strings.midi.preset.comboTooltip: Official and user layouts for this device
strings.midi.actionTooltip: Faders/encoders: None or Volume. Buttons: None or Mute toggle.
strings.midi.saveChangesTooltip: Persist staged channel / mode / action assignments and LED feedback into the active preset
strings.midi.discardTooltip: Revert staged assignments and LED feedback to the last saved preset
strings.midi.resetBindingTooltip: Clear hardware recognition and Sonar assignment (saved immediately)
strings.midi.feedback.title: LED feedback
strings.midi.feedback.tooltip: Host→device lamp. Source = when it lights. Style = solid or blink (pads/encoders only). Faders: Off or Channel assigned (soft-takeover; hardware blinks while Sonar ≠ physical fader). Staged until Save changes.
strings.midi.feedback.sourceTooltip: When the lamp reacts (staged — Save changes to apply).
strings.midi.feedback.styleTooltip: Solid or blink while the source condition is active (pads/encoders).
strings.midi.palette.title: Palette — drop onto areas (edge = beside, center = inside)
strings.midi.palette.label: Label
strings.midi.palette.labelTooltip: Optional caption for the selected control/area (Enter / focus leave). Empty = no title on areas. Also used for the next palette drop.
strings.midi.palette.ledTooltip: Host→device lamp. Source + style. Faders: Off or Channel assigned only. Saved with Save layout.
strings.midi.palette.colSpanTooltip: How many columns this control/area occupies in its parent grid
strings.midi.palette.rowSpanTooltip: How many rows this control/area occupies in its parent grid
strings.midi.palette.colsSpannedTooltip: Columns spanned (1–16). For a wide fader try 2+.
strings.midi.palette.rowsSpannedTooltip: Rows spanned (1–16). Tall faders in the factory map use 4.
strings.midi.palette.hideBorderTooltip: Area only: no solid outline in normal view. In the constructor a dashed outline still shows so you can edit the zone.
strings.midi.palette.keepSpacingTooltip: With Hide border: keep a modest gap around this area (e.g. separate channel strips or the transport row) instead of collapsing nested margins to zero.
strings.midi.palette.hTooltip: Horizontal justify (flex): how children fill extra width when the area stretches.
strings.midi.palette.vTooltip: Vertical align (flex): how children fill extra height when the area stretches.
strings.midi.palette.justifyTooltip: Pack = together at start. Space between = equal gaps between items. Space evenly = equal gaps including edges.
strings.midi.palette.alignTooltip: Pack = together at top. Space between = equal gaps between rows. Space evenly = equal gaps including top/bottom edges.
strings.midi.learnTooltip: Map hardware CC/Note/Pitch Bend to the selected control
strings.midi.cancelLearnTooltip: Stop listening without changing the binding
strings.midi.conflict.title: Volume fighting risk
strings.midi.conflict.message: Are you sure? Multiple non-motorized faders on one channel will cause volume fighting.
strings.midi.conflict.messageWithOwners:
Are you sure? Multiple non-motorized faders on one channel will cause volume fighting.

strings.midi.confirm.switchDevice: Switching device will discard unsaved channel assignments.
strings.midi.confirm.enterConstructor: Opening the layout constructor will discard unsaved channel assignments.

strings.midi.prompt.renameText: New name for this user preset:
strings.midi.import.confirm:
Import a layout JSON as a new user preset for the selected device?

Existing presets stay. MIDI channel bindings are not imported.
strings.midi.delete.confirm:
Delete user layout preset “{0}”?

This cannot be undone. Other presets are kept.
strings.midi.reset.confirm:
Clear all MIDI bindings for “{0}”?

This removes discovered controls and Sonar channel assignments for this device (and its duplicate ports), then restores the factory map. Other devices are left alone.

strings.midi.status.showingDevice: Showing {0}. You can Use device to activate it.

strings.midi.status.assignHint: Assign Sonar channels / LED feedback, then Save changes.

strings.midi.status.selectUserPresetToDelete: Select a user layout preset to delete.
strings.midi.status.presetDeleted: Deleted user preset “{0}”. Switched to official layout.

strings.midi.status.layoutImported: Imported layout “{0}” as a new user preset.
strings.midi.status.learnStartHint: Use device and open Edit layout to Learn hardware.

strings.midi.status.bindingsCleared: Cleared {0} binding(s) on {1}. Move controls to discover them again.
strings.midi.status.controlRemoved: Removed control from layout (bindings cleaned on Save).
strings.midi.status.feedbackOffSave: LED feedback off for {0} (save layout to keep).
strings.midi.status.feedbackSave: LED feedback → {0} for {1} (save layout to keep).

strings.midi.status.feedbackOffMatches: LED feedback off for {0} (matches saved preset).

strings.midi.preset.smcHint: Minimal factory map for DAW Mode / Mode A (Shift+←, Mackie Control): faders = Pitch Bend E0–E7, mute Notes 16–23, encoders = relative CC 16–23. No LED feedback baked in — configure in MIDI Setup. CC Mode / Mode B is Shift+→ (MidiSuite).
